sections.text: مقدمة

This document shows the protective maintenance which must be performed 
 annually on Acc. tank main valve as indicated by Y1 in the 
 title block.

This valve function is to controling the oil flow between 
 ACC tank and the governer

The technical specification of the valve 
 :
gate valve, 6 in

This document is initiated and tested by eng. 
 Mohamed Allethy Ahmad, مُراجع by eng. 
 Abdel Gwad Yosef Mohamed, accepted by eng. Ebrahim Abdel Rahman Ahmad 
 general manager, and approved by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abd El 
 gaber head sector of Aswan Hydraulic power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Osama Solima 
 HPGC general director quality control .

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should will 
 trained & qualified or directly supervised by some one

Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc

Safety rope with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area are required

معدات الحماية الشخصية 
 يجب أن تستخدم
Unit off
Discharge ACC tank sump tank
